metadata.description: Capability benchmark questions (MMLU, GSM8K, commonsense subset)
metadata.note: Sample subset for reproducibility. Full benchmark uses 100 questions.

mmlu_subset.subject: physics
mmlu_subset.question: What is the SI unit of force?

mmlu_subset.subject: physics
mmlu_subset.question: What is the acceleration due to gravity on Earth (approximately)?

mmlu_subset.subject: chemistry
mmlu_subset.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

mmlu_subset.subject: biology
mmlu_subset.question: What organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?

mmlu_subset.subject: history
mmlu_subset.question: In what year did World War II end?

mmlu_subset.subject: geography
mmlu_subset.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?

mmlu_subset.subject: mathematics
mmlu_subset.question: What is the value of pi to two decimal places?

gsm8k_subset.question: John has 5 apples. He buys 3 more apples. How many apples does John have now?
A store sells pencils for $2 each. How much do 7 pencils cost?
Sarah has 24 cookies. She wants to share them equally among 6 friends. How many cookies does each friend get?
A train travels at 60 miles per hour. How far will it travel in 3 hours?
Tom has $50. He spends $23 on a book. How much money does he have left?
A rectangle has a length of 8 cm and a width of 5 cm. What is its area?
Lisa reads 15 pages every day. How many pages will she read in a week?
A baker makes 48 cupcakes. He puts them in boxes of 12. How many boxes does he need?
Mike is 12 years old. His father is 3 times his age. How old is Mike's father?
A school has 450 students. If 30% are in the science club, how many students are in the science club?

commonsense_subset.question: What do you use an umbrella for?
Where would you find a pilot?
What do plants need to perform photosynthesis?
How many legs does a spider have?
What tool would you use to cut paper?
What do fish use to breathe?
What color do you get when you mix red and blue?
